cleanup_wording_sensitivity.ambiguity: Three otherwise complete bytecode-cache answers describe cleanup as preventing leftover partial temporary files. Source remove_silent suppresses removal OSError. Strict review treats these as false outcome guarantees; an ordinary-intent reading of the prose would accept them.

independent_family.full_cohort_token_totals: Unknown for every profile; initialization zeros and partial returned usage are not full cost.
independent_family.interpretation: No fully correct answers in this runtime/configuration, including the 138 completed generations. This accuracy floor and missing usage make retrieval ranking/cost conclusions uninformative; not a general claim about the model family.
independent_family.continuation: After the first parser rejection, each remaining originally scheduled case was attempted once by the unchanged worker. No retry, prompt change, runtime tuning, or dropped failure.
independent_family.failure_message: The model produced output that does not match the expected peg-native format
independent_family.failure_cause: The rejection is observed; why the model/runtime produced an invalid native format is not established.
independent_family.recording_limits: Failed calls have no usage/request snapshot. Three invalid typed native-read calls generated error observations outside tool_outputs; they were reconciled from log/request snapshots. No missing source was silently declared preserved.

development.cohort_note: The initial search-fix sweep and later candidate curve are separate cohorts with matched tasks/settings, not one interleaved causal contrast. The combined table is descriptive; fresh validation pairs every frozen profile within one interleaved schedule.
development.search_fix_comparison: Existing identifier-search fix was measured against pre-fix source at four and six calls; small quality/token changes do not establish the requested overall win.
development.candidate_implementation: Seven retrieval source files and four focused test files per isolated candidate: identifier terms throughout selection, then occurrence-preserving document term frequency as a separate ablation. Public diagnostic extract_keywords behavior retained.
development.packing: 48 packing probes supplied no demonstrated query-required evidence-loss case; no speculative residual packer. All 764 replayed selected blocks passed exact contiguous-source provenance checks.

host_policy.decision: Do not promote batching or discovery masking into production. Use full history for every frozen fresh profile.
rationale: Small single-repetition development cohorts produce unstable quality changes; no reliable token/accuracy win over the optimized native control.
Logical token reductions and published-rate dollar reductions differ because hosted prompt-cache write/read charges differ.
Safe repeated-search unmasking currently depends on in-process retrieval-guard coordination. The experiment does not establish an external MCP host lifecycle protocol.
Batching reuses existing independent calls; thresholds apply between turns and whole batches can overshoot. No new multi-query production API was justified.
host_policy.source_grade_method: Arm-blind coding-assistant source review; not human validation.

query_contract.promotion: Correctness only: query required in MCP schema, explicit empty query still accepted for saved-pack loading. No matched accuracy/token improvement claim from the incomplete hosted cohort.

hosted_limit.fresh_hosted_validation: Not run: Anthropic HTTP 400 insufficient account credits. No purchase or retry. No other configured native tool-calling provider credential was found.
hosted_limit.alternate_helper: The evaluation completion helper is stateless and has no tools/history interface; it was not substituted for the native tool-calling benchmark.

grading.method: Arm-blind coding-assistant source reviews, not independent human validation. Every answer checked against actual source; complete answers need all substantive requested facts and no material false mechanism.
grading.keyword_proxy: Not answer accuracy; never used for the primary promotion decision.
grading.api_grader: Grouped API grades retained as diagnostic only after source audits exposed cross-answer attribution errors and excessive rubric strictness.
grading.corrections: Preserved original reviews. Reversible UTF-8/cp1252 repairs changed no verdicts. Development recursion omissions were adjudicated consistently with the original substantive standard, improving ten pass verdicts (including native baselines). Duplicate tracker categories normalized without pass changes. Final authoritative grade-folder mapping is in all_source_grade_consistency.json.
grading.fresh_reviews: 20 independent repository/model slices; exact quote containment, criterion IDs and completion invariants validated on merge.
grading.ambiguity: Primary cleanup-guarantee decisions retained; a separately reported three-answer ordinary-intent sensitivity does not change the Qwen gate failure.

limitations: Fifty purposively authored fresh questions, all ten fresh repositories Python; not a random sample of coding tasks.
One fresh repetition per profile. Requested seeds do not ensure byte-identical local generations.
Development question reuse and finalist selection make development results exploratory. All finalists were frozen before fresh actors.
Question- and repository-clustered bootstrap intervals are descriptive; ten repositories, no multiple-comparison adjustment, no equivalence claim from nonsignificance.
Never pool raw token counts across model tokenizers.
A stopping threshold is checked between turns; all calls in a returned batch execute and count.
Native baseline is the existing harness regex grep plus line reader, not every possible shell/search workflow.
Tool/host integration failures and unavailable hosted fresh validation limit cross-model conclusions.
Source review remains fallible; it is not independent human validation.

unknown_usage_attempts.reason: HTTP 400 insufficient credits; no usage returned; do not interpret the row initialization value of zero as observed usage.

spend.notes: Published-rate cost from observed usage, not an invoice; excludes taxes/discounts and unmetered coding-assistant/source-review compute. No further grouped API grading planned because source audits found unreliable cross-answer attribution.
spend.blocker: Account credits exhausted before the study spending ceiling. No retries or purchases. Fresh hosted validation unavailable.

production_suite.phase: After production decision, before final report-label-only edits.

isolated_candidate_invariants.command: python -m pytest tests/test_bm25.py tests/test_packing.py tests/test_symbols.py tests/test_evidence.py
isolated_candidate_invariants.each_run_cwd: The respective frozen candidate root, confirmed by pytest rootdir.

actual_report_cli.scope: Component estimates and provider totals; keyword proxy explicitly labeled, not used as answer accuracy.

resolved_verification_issues: One report.py E501 line was split without changing the emitted string.
The first in-process smoke invocation used anyio.run in an already-running Eval async loop; rerun with top-level await succeeded. No model request was involved.

reproduction.status: Retained locally in git-ignored results; not published as an external archive.
reproduction.actors: run_host_policy_study.py --plan qwen_fresh_plan.json|llama_fresh_plan.json --out NEW_DIRECTORY; llama_fresh/continuation_manifest.json documents the no-retry continuation.
reproduction.grading: grade_packets.py, raw fresh_A_* / fresh_B_* source reviews, merge_reviews.py.
reproduction.analysis: summarize.py and fresh_repository_analysis.py; fresh_integrity.py checks frozen hashes and distinguishes missing usage/request evidence.
reproduction.environment: final_environment.json records installed dependency versions, CLI commit, requested context/GPU settings and the exact study-script hashes.
reproduction.warning: Re-running exposed questions is replication, not a new held-out validation. Preserve frozen source trees, model weights and runtime configuration.
